title: Responsive Catalog Layout for Retailers
business: E-commerce retailers managing product catalogs across diverse screen sizes.
problem: Manual CSS media queries for grid layouts create inconsistent padding and alignment issues, leading to high maintenance costs and broken mobile experiences.
solution: Utilizing Bootstrap’s responsive grid system and pre-built components allows developers to standardize layout behavior through utility classes, ensuring consistent padding and alignment without custom CSS.
steps: Include the viewport meta tag in the HTML head to enable mobile-first scaling.
Link the Bootstrap CSS via CDN to apply global box-sizing and Reboot styles.
Define a container element to wrap the product grid.
Apply row and column utility classes (e.g., col-md-4) to structure the product list.
Integrate reusable components like Cards to maintain uniform product display.
outcome: A unified, responsive interface that automatically adjusts product density based on device width, reducing layout-related bugs.
limitation: The global border-box sizing can conflict with specific third-party widgets like embedded maps; check for layout distortion in these areas and override the box-sizing property if necessary.
